title: Do we really need dice? The hidden region-size biases of segmentation losses
mechanism: CE and Dice share a ground-truth matching term and differ in an implicit region-size penalty; replace it with an explicit L1 or KL term matching predicted class proportions to the target.
adaptation: CE + per-image proportion term on crack and inactive, replacing soft Dice; gives explicit control over crack predicted area (width), i.e. the precision-recall balance now set by a post-hoc logit bias.
min_experiment: Arm CE + L1 proportion term vs SUP100, 5 v 5. Kill if crack IoU < +0.012 and no relR@2 gain at relP@2 >= 0.90.
evidence: R: theory plus experiments over several losses and applications showing explicit size terms match or beat Dice (abstract; numbers not read).
